description: This Dart file defines a network client for interacting with the NewsAPI. It includes classes to handle exceptions, fetch news articles based on categories and countries, parse JSON responses, and manage HTTP requests with error handling and debugging support.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to NewsAPI interactions.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Client class responsible for fetching news articles from the NewsAPI with methods for constructing requests, parsing responses, and error handling.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Fetches top news headlines from NewsAPI based on country and category filters.

methods.name: _queryForCategory
methods.description: Generates appropriate query strings for API requests based on news category.

methods.name: _extractNewsApiErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts error messages from the JSON response of NewsAPI.

methods.name: _maskApiKeyInUrl
methods.description: Obfuscates the API key in URL logs for security.

methods.name: _debugLog
methods.description: Logs debug messages when in debug mode.

methods.name: _languageForCountry
methods.description: Maps country codes to language codes for API requests.
